budget_items.topic: Eagle House Red Sox ticket raffle
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Raffle tickets for four Red Sox seats and a Fenway tour were priced at $5.00 each or three for $10.00.
budget_items.quote: tickets will be $5.00 each or thrce for $10.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A very old rescue wagon receivable balance of $108,900.84, unchanged for at least 20 years, was proposed for abatement.
budget_items.quote: ms. brochu reported we have a very old rescue wagon receivable balance in the amount of $108,900.84.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A write-off of $108,900.84 in old ambulance receivables dating before 2003 was recommended as uncollectible.
budget_items.quote: the recommendation before the board is to write-off a total of $108,900.84 from old ambulance receivables that date back prior to 2003

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant for this amount.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $552,144.33.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conveying the old Primary School Building was said to avoid putting $2 million of repair into the building.
budget_items.quote: it is an effort to avoid putting $2 million of repair into the building.

budget_items.topic: Design and engineering for consolidated town offices (Article 24)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 24 asks for an appropriation, from taxation or available funds, for design and engineering of the TCP; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds a sum of money for the design and engincering to consolidate town offices

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2020 budget was discussed, including two new staff positions that Ms. Luck questioned; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: article 7 is the fy2020 budget. ms. luck had issues with the two new staff positions.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Amending the program to raise the hourly wage and maximum abatement for seniors was discussed; no figures are printed.
